# Valid legacy note

A note that predates the memory-metadata layer: no `memory_status`, no `source`, no `confidence`, no lifecycle metadata of any kind. It carries only the base frontmatter contract (`status`/`project`/`type`). Schema-valid, usable as-is, never flagged as broken — and, critically, never treated as an explicit `current` claim (adversarial-suite M3).
